# rustinion_group_detection (Resource)

Manages a group's detection rules. Sigma-compatible rules (a curated starter pack plus the organization's imported rules) run over the group's collected logs; matches are shown on the device with the matched log lines and raise findings. Turning it on also makes the agents collect the sign-in, sudo and account lines and Windows security events the rules read. Destroying this resource turns detection off.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group these settings belong to.

### Optional

- `critical_push` (Boolean) Push an urgent alert when a critical-level rule matches (Windows event log cleared, a new account with user id 0, ...). Default false: findings only reach the summary email.
- `disabled_rules` (List of String) Ids of rules switched off for this group (for example `rustinion-web-not-found`). Default none.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Run detection rules for the group's devices. Default true (the resource exists to turn detection on).
- `min_level` (String) Matches below this level (informational, low, medium, high, critical) are kept and shown but are not findings. Default medium.
- `rule_levels` (Map of String) Rule id to the level this group gives the rule (informational, low, medium, high, critical). Default: each rule's own level.
- `rule_thresholds` (Map of Number) Rule id to the number of matches (or distinct values) a counting rule needs inside its time window. Default: each rule's own threshold.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as group_id.
